dominant_strengths: Confident editorial headline scale paired with a quirky illustration creates strong brand voice consistent with Notion's identity
Clean nav, restrained palette, and well-balanced left-text/right-art hero composition feel native and uncluttered
Feature chip row (Agents, Enterprise search, Meeting Notes, Admin) cleanly compresses scope into scannable, parallel cards
dominant_weaknesses: Body copy under the headline is generic and lacks hierarchy contrast; feels like filler beneath such a bold H1 statement
Feature chips use four near-identical blue glyphs—no visual differentiation, weakening category legibility and reducing system creativity
Trusted-by logo strip visually outweighs the proof it carries; spacing is loose and grayscale logos float without rhythm
fix_priorities: Differentiate the four feature chips with distinct icons/colors or micro-illustrations to signal capability variety
Tighten subhead copy and increase its weight contrast vs. headline to sharpen the value proposition
Rebalance the logo strip with consistent optical sizing and tighter vertical rhythm
Introduce subtle motion or hover affordance on chips to elevate the static reflective layer
rationale.norman_balance: Visceral lands via illustration charm, behavioral is competent but undifferentiated in the feature row, and reflective meaning ('24/7 AI team') is asserted more than demonstrated.
rationale.intent_fit: Yes—it clearly frames Notion AI as a teamwork-augmenting agent suite, though it leans on brand familiarity rather than proving the product surface.
